title: A Simple Way to Break a Bad Habit

cues.text: When I was first learning to meditate,
cues.en: When I was first learning to meditate,
cues.zh: 當我第一次學習冥想的時候，

cues.text: the instruction was to simply pay attention to my breath,
cues.en: the instruction was to simply pay attention to my breath,
cues.zh: 得到的指示就是， 簡單地注意自己的呼吸，

cues.text: and when my mind wandered, to bring it back.
cues.en: and when my mind wandered, to bring it back.
cues.zh: 而如果心思遊走了， 就把它拉回來。

cues.text: Sounded simple enough.
cues.en: Sounded simple enough.
cues.zh: 聽起來很簡單。

cues.text: Yet I'd sit on these silent retreats,
cues.en: Yet I'd sit on these silent retreats,
cues.zh: 但當我在靜坐冥想時，

cues.text: sweating through T-shirts in the middle of winter.
cues.en: sweating through T-shirts in the middle of winter.
cues.zh: 嚴冬也會讓我汗流浹背。

cues.text: I'd take naps every chance I got because it was really hard work.
cues.en: I'd take naps every chance I got because it was really hard work.
cues.zh: 我總會把握每個可能的機會小睡片刻， 因為靜坐冥想也是一番功夫。

cues.text: Actually, it was exhausting.
cues.en: Actually, it was exhausting.
cues.zh: 其實是筋疲力盡了。

cues.text: The instruction was simple enough
cues.en: The instruction was simple enough
cues.zh: 指示是很簡單，

cues.text: but I was missing something really important.
cues.en: but I was missing something really important.
cues.zh: 但我錯過了很多重要之處。

cues.text: So why is it so hard to pay attention?
cues.en: So why is it so hard to pay attention?
cues.zh: 那為什麼專注會這麼困難呢？

cues.text: Well, studies show
cues.en: Well, studies show
cues.zh: 根據研究指出，

cues.text: that even when we're really trying to pay attention to something --
cues.en: that even when we're really trying to pay attention to something --
cues.zh: 就算是我們嘗試著專注於一些事情 --

cues.text: like maybe this talk --
cues.en: like maybe this talk --
cues.zh: 就好像這個演講 --

cues.text: at some point,
cues.en: at some point,
cues.zh: 到了某個時間點，

cues.text: about half of us will drift off into a daydream,
cues.en: about half of us will drift off into a daydream,
cues.zh: 我們當中會有一半的人， 都會恍惚進入神遊狀態，

cues.text: or have this urge to check our Twitter feed.
cues.en: or have this urge to check our Twitter feed.
cues.zh: 或是會有一種念頭， 去檢視一下推特的內容。

cues.text: So what's going on here?
cues.en: So what's going on here?
cues.zh: 那到底是怎麼回事呢？

cues.text: It turns out that we're fighting one of the most evolutionarily-conserved
cues.en: It turns out that we're fighting one of the most evolutionarily-conserved
cues.zh: 原來我們與之抗爭的， 是一種最近被科學界發現的 --

cues.text: learning processes currently known in science,
cues.en: learning processes currently known in science,
cues.zh: 「演化保守」的學習過程，

cues.text: one that's conserved
cues.en: one that's conserved
cues.zh: 它會保守護存著

cues.text: back to the most basic nervous systems known to man.
cues.en: back to the most basic nervous systems known to man.
cues.zh: 回到人類所知的 最基本神經系統裡頭。

cues.text: This reward-based learning process
cues.en: This reward-based learning process
cues.zh: 這類以獎勵為本的學習過程，

cues.text: is called positive and negative reinforcement,
cues.en: is called positive and negative reinforcement,
cues.zh: 稱之為正面的和負面的強化，

cues.text: and basically goes like this.
cues.en: and basically goes like this.
cues.zh: 基本上是這樣執行的。

cues.text: We see some food that looks good,
cues.en: We see some food that looks good,
cues.zh: 我們看到了看起來好吃的食物，

cues.text: our brain says, "Calories! ... Survival!"
cues.en: our brain says, "Calories! ... Survival!"
cues.zh: 我們的大腦會說： 「卡路里！...... 生存！」

cues.text: We eat the food, we taste it --
cues.en: We eat the food, we taste it --
cues.zh: 我們把食物吃下去， 我們嚐了味道 --

cues.text: it tastes good.
cues.en: it tastes good.
cues.zh: 食物的味道很好。

cues.text: And especially with sugar,
cues.en: And especially with sugar,
cues.zh: 尤其是有加糖的，

cues.text: our bodies send a signal to our brain that says,
cues.en: our bodies send a signal to our brain that says,
cues.zh: 我們的身體就會向大腦發出訊息說，

cues.text: "Remember what you're eating and where you found it."
cues.en: "Remember what you're eating and where you found it."
cues.zh: 「要記住你在吃甚麼和從哪裡找到的。」

cues.text: We lay down this context-dependent memory
cues.en: We lay down this context-dependent memory
cues.zh: 我們種下了這「情境關連」的記憶

cues.text: and learn to repeat the process next time.
cues.en: and learn to repeat the process next time.
cues.zh: 學懂了下一趟再重覆這個過程。

cues.text: See food,
cues.en: See food,
cues.zh: 看到食物，

cues.text: eat food, feel good,
cues.en: eat food, feel good,
cues.zh: 吃下食物，感覺良好。

cues.text: repeat.
cues.en: repeat.
cues.zh: 重覆。

cues.text: Trigger, behavior, reward.
cues.en: Trigger, behavior, reward.
cues.zh: 觸發、行為、獎勵。

cues.text: Simple, right?
cues.en: Simple, right?
cues.zh: 簡單，對不對？

cues.text: Well, after a while, our creative brains say,
cues.en: Well, after a while, our creative brains say,
cues.zh: 這樣過了一陣子， 我們富有創意的腦袋就會說：

cues.text: "You know what?
cues.en: "You know what?
cues.zh: 「 你知道嗎？

cues.text: You can use this for more than just remembering where food is.
cues.en: You can use this for more than just remembering where food is.
cues.zh: 你不只可以利用這個過程 來記住食物在哪裡，

cues.text: You know, next time you feel bad,
cues.en: You know, next time you feel bad,
cues.zh: 而且還可以 在下一次你感覺糟糕時，

cues.text: why don't you try eating something good so you'll feel better?"
cues.en: why don't you try eating something good so you'll feel better?"
cues.zh: 嘗試吃一些好吃的食物， 來讓你感覺好一點？」

cues.text: We thank our brains for the great idea,
cues.en: We thank our brains for the great idea,
cues.zh: 我們感謝自己的腦袋裡 有這麼好的點子，

cues.text: try this and quickly learn
cues.en: try this and quickly learn
cues.zh: 試著這樣做並且很快就學會，

cues.text: that if we eat chocolate or ice cream when we're mad or sad,
cues.en: that if we eat chocolate or ice cream when we're mad or sad,
cues.zh: 當我們生氣或是傷心的時候， 如果我們吃下巧克力或雪糕，

cues.text: we feel better.
cues.en: we feel better.
cues.zh: 我們的感覺就會好一點。

cues.text: Same process,
cues.en: Same process,
cues.zh: 同樣的過程，

cues.text: just a different trigger.
cues.en: just a different trigger.
cues.zh: 只是不一樣的觸發方式。

cues.text: Instead of this hunger signal coming from our stomach,
cues.en: Instead of this hunger signal coming from our stomach,
cues.zh: 本來是來自我們胃裡的飢餓訊息，

cues.text: this emotional signal -- feeling sad --
cues.en: this emotional signal -- feeling sad --
cues.zh: 這個情感上的訊息 -- 感到傷心 --

cues.text: triggers that urge to eat.
cues.en: triggers that urge to eat.
cues.zh: 觸發了吃的慾望。

cues.text: Maybe in our teenage years,
cues.en: Maybe in our teenage years,
cues.zh: 大概在我們的青少年時期，

cues.text: we were a nerd at school,
cues.en: we were a nerd at school,
cues.zh: 我們都是阿呆，

cues.text: and we see those rebel kids outside smoking and we think,
cues.en: and we see those rebel kids outside smoking and we think,
cues.zh: 看著那些站在校園外吸煙的叛逆少年， 我們也都會想，

cues.text: "Hey, I want to be cool."
cues.en: "Hey, I want to be cool."
cues.zh: " 嘿！我也想要耍酷 "

cues.text: So we start smoking.
cues.en: So we start smoking.
cues.zh: 於是我們開始抽煙。

cues.text: The Marlboro Man wasn't a dork, and that was no accident.
cues.en: The Marlboro Man wasn't a dork, and that was no accident.
cues.zh: 所以萬寶路男人不是笨蛋， 這並不意外。

cues.text: See cool,
cues.en: See cool,
cues.zh: 看到耍酷，

cues.text: smoke to be cool,
cues.en: smoke to be cool,
cues.zh: 吸煙耍酷，

cues.text: feel good. Repeat.
cues.en: feel good. Repeat.
cues.zh: 感覺良好，重覆。

cues.text: Trigger, behavior, reward.
cues.en: Trigger, behavior, reward.
cues.zh: 觸發、行為、獎勵。

cues.text: And each time we do this,
cues.en: And each time we do this,
cues.zh: 每一次我們這樣做，

cues.text: we learn to repeat the process
cues.en: we learn to repeat the process
cues.zh: 我們學懂了去重覆這個過程

cues.text: and it becomes a habit.
cues.en: and it becomes a habit.
cues.zh: 從而把這個過程養成了習慣。

cues.text: So later,
cues.en: So later,
cues.zh: 所以再過一陣子，

cues.text: feeling stressed out triggers that urge to smoke a cigarette
cues.en: feeling stressed out triggers that urge to smoke a cigarette
cues.zh: 感覺有壓力的時候， 就會觸發慾望去吸煙

cues.text: or to eat something sweet.
cues.en: or to eat something sweet.
cues.zh: 或是去吃一些甜的東西。

cues.text: Now, with these same brain processes,
cues.en: Now, with these same brain processes,
cues.zh: 伴隨這些相同的大腦過程，

cues.text: we've gone from learning to survive
cues.en: we've gone from learning to survive
cues.zh: 我們體會了從學習到生存，

cues.text: to literally killing ourselves with these habits.
cues.en: to literally killing ourselves with these habits.
cues.zh: 到簡直是用這些習慣 在殘害著我們自己。

cues.text: Obesity and smoking
cues.en: Obesity and smoking
cues.zh: 肥胖和吸煙

cues.text: are among the leading preventable causes of morbidity and mortality in the world.
cues.en: are among the leading preventable causes of morbidity and mortality in the world.
cues.zh: 是全世界數一數二發病率 和致命率極高的可預防疾病。

cues.text: So back to my breath.
cues.en: So back to my breath.
cues.zh: 所以，回到我的呼吸。

cues.text: What if instead of fighting our brains,
cues.en: What if instead of fighting our brains,
cues.zh: 假設我們不要再跟腦袋去抗爭，

cues.text: or trying to force ourselves to pay attention,
cues.en: or trying to force ourselves to pay attention,
cues.zh: 也不要再強逼自己去專注，

cues.text: we instead tapped into this natural, reward-based learning process ...
cues.en: we instead tapped into this natural, reward-based learning process ...
cues.zh: 取而代之，我們藉助這個天然的、 以獎勵為本的學習過程......

cues.text: but added a twist?
cues.en: but added a twist?
cues.zh: 然後稍微改變扭轉一下？

cues.text: What if instead we just got really curious
cues.en: What if instead we just got really curious
cues.zh: 假設我們變得很好奇，

cues.text: about what was happening in our momentary experience?
cues.en: about what was happening in our momentary experience?
cues.zh: 想了解自己的瞬間體驗 到底是怎樣一回事？

cues.text: I'll give you an example.
cues.en: I'll give you an example.
cues.zh: 我會給你們一個例子。

cues.text: In my lab,
cues.en: In my lab,
cues.zh: 在我的實驗室，

cues.text: we studied whether mindfulness training could help people quit smoking.
cues.en: we studied whether mindfulness training could help people quit smoking.
cues.zh: 我們研究冥想的訓練 是不是可以幫助人們戒掉吸煙。

cues.text: Now, just like trying to force myself to pay attention to my breath,
cues.en: Now, just like trying to force myself to pay attention to my breath,
cues.zh: 其實，就像嘗試著強迫自己 去專注於呼吸一樣，

cues.text: they could try to force themselves to quit smoking.
cues.en: they could try to force themselves to quit smoking.
cues.zh: 他們也可以嘗試著去強迫自己戒煙。

cues.text: And the majority of them had tried this before and failed --
cues.en: And the majority of them had tried this before and failed --
cues.zh: 他們大部份人都曾經這樣嘗試， 但都失敗了 --

cues.text: on average, six times.
cues.en: on average, six times.
cues.zh: 平均來說，嘗試過六次。

cues.text: Now, with mindfulness training,
cues.en: Now, with mindfulness training,
cues.zh: 現在，要是用冥想的訓練，

cues.text: we dropped the bit about forcing and instead focused on being curious.
cues.en: we dropped the bit about forcing and instead focused on being curious.
cues.zh: 我們把強迫的那部份去掉， 取而代之的是專注於好奇。

cues.text: In fact, we even told them to smoke.
cues.en: In fact, we even told them to smoke.
cues.zh: 事實上，我們甚至吩咐他們抽菸。

cues.text: What? Yeah, we said, "Go ahead and smoke,
cues.en: What? Yeah, we said, "Go ahead and smoke,
cues.zh: 甚麼？是呀，我們說，" 去抽菸就對了，

cues.text: just be really curious about what it's like when you do."
cues.en: just be really curious about what it's like when you do."
cues.zh: 只是在抽菸的時候，真心的去好奇一下 抽菸到底是怎麼回事。"

cues.text: And what did they notice?
cues.en: And what did they notice?
cues.zh: 結果他們覺察到了什麼？

cues.text: Well here's an example from one of our smokers.
cues.en: Well here's an example from one of our smokers.
cues.zh: 讓我們來看看其中的一位抽菸者怎麼說。

cues.text: She said, "Mindful smoking:
cues.en: She said, "Mindful smoking:
cues.zh: 她說，「 專注地抽菸：

cues.text: smells like stinky cheese
cues.en: smells like stinky cheese
cues.zh: 聞起來就像發臭的乳酪，

cues.text: and tastes like chemicals,
cues.en: and tastes like chemicals,
cues.zh: 味道則好像化學製品，

cues.text: YUCK!"
cues.en: YUCK!"
cues.zh: 超噁心！」

cues.text: Now, she knew, cognitively that smoking was bad for her,
cues.en: Now, she knew, cognitively that smoking was bad for her,
cues.zh: 其實在認知上，她知道，抽菸會危害她，

cues.text: that's why she joined our program.
cues.en: that's why she joined our program.
cues.zh: 正因如此，她參加我們的計劃。

cues.text: What she discovered just by being curiously aware when she smoked
cues.en: What she discovered just by being curiously aware when she smoked
cues.zh: 她發現，在抽菸的時候，只要好奇地去體會，

cues.text: was that smoking tastes like shit.
cues.en: was that smoking tastes like shit.
cues.zh: 就會察覺到菸的味道像大便。

cues.text: (Laughter)
cues.en: (Laughter)
cues.zh: （笑聲）

cues.text: Now, she moved from knowledge to wisdom.
cues.en: Now, she moved from knowledge to wisdom.
cues.zh: 現在，她從知識昇華到智慧。

cues.text: She moved from knowing in her head that smoking was bad for her
cues.en: She moved from knowing in her head that smoking was bad for her
cues.zh: 她從腦袋裡開始瞭解抽菸對她有害

cues.text: to knowing it in her bones,
cues.en: to knowing it in her bones,
cues.zh: 並昇華到骨子裡去，

cues.text: and the spell of smoking was broken.
cues.en: and the spell of smoking was broken.
cues.zh: 就破解了抽菸的魔咒。

cues.text: She started to become disenchanted with her behavior.
cues.en: She started to become disenchanted with her behavior.
cues.zh: 她開始對她的行為產生覺悟。

cues.text: Now, the prefrontal cortex,
cues.en: Now, the prefrontal cortex,
cues.zh: 其實，前額葉皮質，

cues.text: that youngest part of our brain from an evolutionary perspective,
cues.en: that youngest part of our brain from an evolutionary perspective,
cues.zh: 從進化的角度來看， 那是我們大腦最年輕的部份，

cues.text: it understands on an intellectual level that we shouldn't smoke.
cues.en: it understands on an intellectual level that we shouldn't smoke.
cues.zh: 它明白，理智上我們不應該抽菸。

cues.text: And it tries its hardest to help us change our behavior,
cues.en: And it tries its hardest to help us change our behavior,
cues.zh: 然後它嘗試盡最大的努力， 去幫助我們改變自己的行為、

cues.text: to help us stop smoking,
cues.en: to help us stop smoking,
cues.zh: 幫助我們戒菸，

cues.text: to help us stop eating that second, that third, that fourth cookie.
cues.en: to help us stop eating that second, that third, that fourth cookie.
cues.zh: 要幫助我們去戒掉吃第二塊、 第三塊、第四塊曲奇餅。

cues.text: We call this cognitive control.
cues.en: We call this cognitive control.
cues.zh: 我們稱之為「認知控制」。

cues.text: We're using cognition to control our behavior.
cues.en: We're using cognition to control our behavior.
cues.zh: 我們用認知去控制自己的行為。

cues.text: Unfortunately,
cues.en: Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 很不幸的是，

cues.text: this is also the first part of our brain
cues.en: this is also the first part of our brain
cues.zh: 當我們過度勞累時，這也是我們腦袋裡，

cues.text: that goes offline when we get stressed out,
cues.en: that goes offline when we get stressed out,
cues.zh: 率先離線的部份。

cues.text: which isn't that helpful.
cues.en: which isn't that helpful.
cues.zh: 所以不太能夠幫得上忙。

cues.text: Now, we can all relate to this in our own experience.
cues.en: Now, we can all relate to this in our own experience.
cues.zh: 其實我們大家都可以找到 自己類似的經驗。

cues.text: We're much more likely to do things like yell at our spouse or kids
cues.en: We're much more likely to do things like yell at our spouse or kids
cues.zh: 當我們壓力過大或是很勞累時，

cues.text: when we're stressed out or tired,
cues.en: when we're stressed out or tired,
cues.zh: 我們有很大的可能， 會向自己的伴侶或小孩吼叫，

cues.text: even though we know it's not going to be helpful.
cues.en: even though we know it's not going to be helpful.
cues.zh: 雖然我們知道， 這樣的吼叫並沒有幫助。

cues.text: We just can't help ourselves.
cues.en: We just can't help ourselves.
cues.zh: 只是我們控制不了自己。

cues.text: When the prefrontal cortex goes offline,
cues.en: When the prefrontal cortex goes offline,
cues.zh: 在前額葉皮質 處於離線狀態時，

cues.text: we fall back into our old habits,
cues.en: we fall back into our old habits,
cues.zh: 我們會墜落回老習慣，

cues.text: which is why this disenchantment is so important.
cues.en: which is why this disenchantment is so important.
cues.zh: 這是為什麼覺悟是這麼的重要。

cues.text: Seeing what we get from our habits
cues.en: Seeing what we get from our habits
cues.zh: 明白我們如何養成習慣

cues.text: helps us understand them at a deeper level --
cues.en: helps us understand them at a deeper level --
cues.zh: 可以幫助我們更深層次的去了解它們 --

cues.text: to know it in our bones
cues.en: to know it in our bones
cues.zh: 讓我們從骨子裡去明白，

cues.text: so we don't have to force ourselves to hold back
cues.en: so we don't have to force ourselves to hold back
cues.zh: 那我們就不需要再強逼自己去憋住

cues.text: or restrain ourselves from behavior.
cues.en: or restrain ourselves from behavior.
cues.zh: 或是去遏止自己的行為。

cues.text: We're just less interested in doing it in the first place.
cues.en: We're just less interested in doing it in the first place.
cues.zh: 我們只是在一開始的時候 沒有太大的興趣去做這件事。

cues.text: And this is what mindfulness is all about:
cues.en: And this is what mindfulness is all about:
cues.zh: 這就是冥想：

cues.text: Seeing really clearly what we get when we get caught up in our behaviors,
cues.en: Seeing really clearly what we get when we get caught up in our behaviors,
cues.zh: 當我們被自己的行為絆住的時候， 得真的很清醒得去了解，我們得到的是什麼，

cues.text: becoming disenchanted on a visceral level
cues.en: becoming disenchanted on a visceral level
cues.zh: 發自內心層次的覺悟，

cues.text: and from this disenchanted stance, naturally letting go.
cues.en: and from this disenchanted stance, naturally letting go.
cues.zh: 在覺悟的狀態下，自然地放它走。

cues.text: This isn't to say that, poof, magically we quit smoking.
cues.en: This isn't to say that, poof, magically we quit smoking.
cues.zh: 這不是在說，神奇的 " 噗 "的一聲， 我們就戒菸了。

cues.text: But over time, as we learn to see more and more clearly
cues.en: But over time, as we learn to see more and more clearly
cues.zh: 而是日積月累，當我們學會 看得愈來愈清楚

cues.text: the results of our actions,
cues.en: the results of our actions,
cues.zh: 我們行為所導致的結果，

cues.text: we let go of old habits and form new ones.
cues.en: we let go of old habits and form new ones.
cues.zh: 我們就會摒除掉老習慣， 而養成了新的習慣。

cues.text: The paradox here
cues.en: The paradox here
cues.zh: 吊詭的是，

cues.text: is that mindfulness is just about being really interested
cues.en: is that mindfulness is just about being really interested
cues.zh: 冥想是，打從內心的感到有興趣，

cues.text: in getting close and personal
cues.en: in getting close and personal
cues.zh: 時時刻刻很私密的去體會

cues.text: with what's actually happening in our bodies and minds
cues.en: with what's actually happening in our bodies and minds
cues.zh: 到底我們的身體和心智，發生了什麼事。

cues.text: from moment to moment.
cues.en: from moment to moment.
cues.zh: 將這種意願轉換成我們的體驗

cues.text: This willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.en: This willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.zh: 將這種意願轉換成我們的體驗

cues.text: rather than trying to make unpleasant cravings go away as quickly as possible.
cues.en: rather than trying to make unpleasant cravings go away as quickly as possible.
cues.zh: 而不是嘗試得儘快把 不好的癮念去除。

cues.text: And this willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.en: And this willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.zh: 將意願轉換成體驗

cues.text: is supported by curiosity,
cues.en: is supported by curiosity,
cues.zh: 是源由自好奇，

cues.text: which is naturally rewarding.
cues.en: which is naturally rewarding.
cues.zh: 那是先天性的一種獎勵機制。

cues.text: What does curiosity feel like?
cues.en: What does curiosity feel like?
cues.zh: 好奇的感覺是怎樣的呢？

cues.text: It feels good.
cues.en: It feels good.
cues.zh: 感覺很好。

cues.text: And what happens when we get curious?
cues.en: And what happens when we get curious?
cues.zh: 我們感到好奇的時候會發生什麼事情呢？

cues.text: We start to notice that cravings are simply made up of body sensations --
cues.en: We start to notice that cravings are simply made up of body sensations --
cues.zh: 我們會開始察覺到，癮念其實單就是 從身體的感官所造成 --

cues.text: oh, there's tightness, there's tension,
cues.en: oh, there's tightness, there's tension,
cues.zh: 噢，那裡很緊張，那邊有壓力

cues.text: there's restlessness --
cues.en: there's restlessness --
cues.zh: 那邊煩躁不安 --

cues.text: and that these body sensations come and go.
cues.en: and that these body sensations come and go.
cues.zh: 這些身體的感覺來來去去。

cues.text: These are bite-size pieces of experiences
cues.en: These are bite-size pieces of experiences
cues.zh: 這些都是我們時時刻刻

cues.text: that we can manage from moment to moment
cues.en: that we can manage from moment to moment
cues.zh: 都可以處理好的小體驗，

cues.text: rather than getting clobbered by this huge, scary craving
cues.en: rather than getting clobbered by this huge, scary craving
cues.zh: 無需被這巨大可怕的

cues.text: that we choke on.
cues.en: that we choke on.
cues.zh: 癮念所噎住並擊倒。

cues.text: In other words, when we get curious,
cues.en: In other words, when we get curious,
cues.zh: 換句話來說，當我們感到好奇，

cues.text: we step out of our old, fear-based, reactive habit patterns,
cues.en: we step out of our old, fear-based, reactive habit patterns,
cues.zh: 我們就走出舊有的、恐懼為本的、 回應式的習慣模式，

cues.text: and we step into being.
cues.en: and we step into being.
cues.zh: 我們從而踏進了當下。

cues.text: We become this inner scientist
cues.en: We become this inner scientist
cues.zh: 我們成為了熱切地期待著下一個資料點的

cues.text: where we're eagerly awaiting that next data point.
cues.en: where we're eagerly awaiting that next data point.
cues.zh: 內心科學家。

cues.text: Now, this might sound too simplistic to affect behavior.
cues.en: Now, this might sound too simplistic to affect behavior.
cues.zh: 這聽起來，好像太簡單到 沒那麼容易可以影響行為。

cues.text: But in one study, we found that mindfulness training
cues.en: But in one study, we found that mindfulness training
cues.zh: 但有一個研究顯示， 我們發現了冥想的訓練，

cues.text: was twice as good as gold standard therapy at helping people quit smoking.
cues.en: was twice as good as gold standard therapy at helping people quit smoking.
cues.zh: 在幫助人們戒菸的這事情上， 比黃金標準治療法好 2 倍

cues.text: So it actually works.
cues.en: So it actually works.
cues.zh: 所以冥想真的有效。

cues.text: And when we studied the brains of experienced meditators,
cues.en: And when we studied the brains of experienced meditators,
cues.zh: 當我們研究資深冥想者的大腦時，

cues.text: we found that parts of a neural network of self-referential processing
cues.en: we found that parts of a neural network of self-referential processing
cues.zh: 我們發現了神經網路裡面 「自我指認流程」的部分

cues.text: called the default mode network
cues.en: called the default mode network
cues.zh: 被稱為「預設模式網路」

cues.text: were at play.
cues.en: were at play.
cues.zh: 正在產生影響。

cues.text: Now, one current hypothesis is that a region of this network,
cues.en: Now, one current hypothesis is that a region of this network,
cues.zh: 目前是有一個 關於這個網路某區域的理論，

cues.text: called the posterior cingulate cortex,
cues.en: called the posterior cingulate cortex,
cues.zh: 稱為「後扣帶回皮質」，

cues.text: is activated not necessarily by craving itself
cues.en: is activated not necessarily by craving itself
cues.zh: 會因為癮念本身而引發不必要的啟動。

cues.text: but when we get caught up in it, when we get sucked in,
cues.en: but when we get caught up in it, when we get sucked in,
cues.zh: 但當我們被它牽絆住， 當我們被吸進去的時候，

cues.text: and it takes us for a ride.
cues.en: and it takes us for a ride.
cues.zh: 它會欺騙我們。

cues.text: In contrast, when we let go --
cues.en: In contrast, when we let go --
cues.zh: 相反來說，如果我們就讓它走--

cues.text: step out of the process
cues.en: step out of the process
cues.zh: 從流程裡走出來

cues.text: just by being curiously aware of what's happening --
cues.en: just by being curiously aware of what's happening --
cues.zh: 只是單純的好奇 到底發生甚麼事情--

cues.text: this same brain region quiets down.
cues.en: this same brain region quiets down.
cues.zh: 同一區域的大腦就會安靜下來。

cues.text: Now we're testing app and online-based mindfulness training programs
cues.en: Now we're testing app and online-based mindfulness training programs
cues.zh: 現在我們在測試手機應用程式和 以網路為基礎的冥想訓練課程，

cues.text: that target these core mechanisms
cues.en: that target these core mechanisms
cues.zh: 目標就是這些核心機制，

cues.text: and, ironically, use the same technology that's driving us to distraction
cues.en: and, ironically, use the same technology that's driving us to distraction
cues.zh: 諷刺的是，竟是使用同一種 讓我們分心的科技

cues.text: to help us step out of our unhealthy habit patterns
cues.en: to help us step out of our unhealthy habit patterns
cues.zh: 去幫助我們脫離自己不健康的習慣模式，

cues.text: of smoking, of stress eating and other addictive behaviors.
cues.en: of smoking, of stress eating and other addictive behaviors.
cues.zh: 像是吸煙、因壓力而狂吃 和其他上癮的行為。

cues.text: Now, remember that bit about context-dependent memory?
cues.en: Now, remember that bit about context-dependent memory?
cues.zh: 現在，還記得剛才曾提過的情境記憶嗎？

cues.text: We can deliver these tools to peoples' fingertips
cues.en: We can deliver these tools to peoples' fingertips
cues.zh: 我們可以把這些最重要的

cues.text: in the contexts that matter most.
cues.en: in the contexts that matter most.
cues.zh: 內容工具傳遞到人們的指尖。

cues.text: So we can help them
cues.en: So we can help them
cues.zh: 所以我們可以幫助他們

cues.text: tap into their inherent capacity to be curiously aware
cues.en: tap into their inherent capacity to be curiously aware
cues.zh: 在渴望抽菸、遇壓力亂吃或 任何不好的慾望浮現的霎那，

cues.text: right when that urge to smoke or stress eat or whatever arises.
cues.en: right when that urge to smoke or stress eat or whatever arises.
cues.zh: 挖掘他們的內心潛力 去好奇地意識正確。

cues.text: So if you don't smoke or stress eat,
cues.en: So if you don't smoke or stress eat,
cues.zh: 所以如果你不抽菸、 也沒有因為壓力而狂吃，

cues.text: maybe the next time you feel this urge to check your email when you're bored,
cues.en: maybe the next time you feel this urge to check your email when you're bored,
cues.zh: 可能下一次你在無聊的時候 想去檢查電郵，

cues.text: or you're trying to distract yourself from work,
cues.en: or you're trying to distract yourself from work,
cues.zh: 或是你想在工作時間透一下氣，

cues.text: or maybe to compulsively respond to that text message when you're driving,
cues.en: or maybe to compulsively respond to that text message when you're driving,
cues.zh: 又或在開車時， 有不得不回覆訊息的義務，

cues.text: see if you can tap into this natural capacity,
cues.en: see if you can tap into this natural capacity,
cues.zh: 看看你是不是可以，藉助這先天的能力，

cues.text: just be curiously aware
cues.en: just be curiously aware
cues.zh: 就單純的去好奇

cues.text: of what's happening in your body and mind in that moment.
cues.en: of what's happening in your body and mind in that moment.
cues.zh: 到底那一刻，你的身體和心智 在發生什麼事。

cues.text: It will just be another chance
cues.en: It will just be another chance
cues.zh: 這可能提供了一個機會

cues.text: to perpetuate one of our endless and exhaustive habit loops ...
cues.en: to perpetuate one of our endless and exhaustive habit loops ...
cues.zh: 讓你持續保有這個永無止境 和消耗性的惡性迴圈......

cues.text: or step out of it.
cues.en: or step out of it.
cues.zh: 或是擺脫掉它。

cues.text: Instead of see text message, compulsively text back,
cues.en: Instead of see text message, compulsively text back,
cues.zh: 看見訊息時，不要再 -- 不得不的回覆

cues.text: feel a little bit better --
cues.en: feel a little bit better --
cues.zh: 反而應該是有蠻好的感覺 --

cues.text: notice the urge,
cues.en: notice the urge,
cues.zh: 察覺到渴望，

cues.text: get curious,
cues.en: get curious,
cues.zh: 感到好奇，

cues.text: feel the joy of letting go
cues.en: feel the joy of letting go
cues.zh: 感受一下放走它的歡愉，

cues.text: and repeat.
cues.en: and repeat.
cues.zh: 然後重覆。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）
